decisions.reason: As a hearty everyday bread closely tied to the bakery’s core craft and existing production, it remains a sensible standard item, though the lack of later website evidence slightly raises the risk of range pruning.
A sweet pastry fits the firm’s established confectionery offer and sales channels well, but pastries are somewhat more exposed to assortment rotation than staple breads.
Crusty farmhouse bread is very close to the traditional bakery range and should benefit from demand for regional, rustic staples, making withdrawal unlikely.
The poppy seed Christmas stollen was highlighted as a flagship product and supported by a gold award, so it is highly likely to stay as a signature seasonal item.

The premium Christmas stollen also has award-backed quality and strong fit with the firm’s festive specialty business, though overlap with other stollen variants creates a modest rationalization risk.
